question: Estimate impressions for a beauty brand campaign on YouTube India with a ₹2 Cr budget.
idealClarificationQuestions: All YouTube ad formats: skippable in-stream + non-skippable + bumper + Shorts + Discovery? Mix all.
Audience: women 18-40 in metros + Tier 2 (beauty buyer profile)? Yes.
Optimization: maximize impressions or video views? Impressions.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Budget / CPM = impressions, segmented by ad format.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average CPM on YouTube India for beauty/female-skewed audience: ~₹40-50 (lower than Instagram for video views; higher for premium skippable).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Skippable in-stream (TrueView): ~50% = 2.2 crore (~70% are skipped before 5 sec).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~4.4 crore impressions; ~1.6 crore unique women reached.
